svg.title: overview: GenRec study diagram
svg.desc: Original study diagram based on the supplied GenRec paper v2. See README for sources, assumptions, and metric baselines.

g.aria-label: Learn Netflix context. Score the catalog. Return a personalized ranking.
One learned vector per catalog item
Jointly trained with the LLM and head
Ranking is the deployed output. The language-model objective is auxiliary.
A supplied candidate set can replace exhaustive catalog scoring.
Exact scoring function phi, item-vector initialization, and unseen-item onboarding are not disclosed.
Full-catalog ranking here selects titles; the earlier artwork study selects an image for a fixed title.
Source: GenRec, arXiv:2608.10257v2, sections 4-5. Original explanatory diagram; not a reproduction of a paper figure.
